# Nice Catch!

> Nice Catch! (Nice Catch AI (Pty) Ltd, getnicecatch.com) is an AI search visibility (GEO) service based in Johannesburg, South Africa. It audits how AI assistants and AI search answers describe and recommend rental and property management software companies, shows which competitors are named instead, and gives a ranked fix list, a re-test and optional monthly tracking. It is not connected to Catch (getcatch.ai) or other companies with similar names.

## Services
- AI visibility audit: at least ten agreed buyer questions, asked at least five times each across the main AI assistants and AI search answers, in clean sessions; results as rates per engine; competitors and cited sources; AI crawler access and brand description checks; ranked fix list; delivered in about a week; fixed price.
- Monthly AI visibility plan (optional, follows the audit): monthly re-test, crawler and description checks, visits from AI assistants measured in the client's Google Analytics 4, and next fixes. Three months suggested; month to month available.

## Who it's for
- Vacation rental and short-term rental software: https://getnicecatch.com/vacation-rental-software/
- Property management and landlord software: https://getnicecatch.com/property-management-software/
